evidence: Decompiled VAudio.cs and disassembled Form1.ManipulatePacket (0x700e4d..0x704920), SendFile_Up (0x747210), SaveUpload (0x7579a0), and Sound (0x6e8610)

decision: Structure Rust crate into protocol, screen, input, audio, clipboard, file_transfer, session, and server modules
why: Keep wire codecs and state machines pure and testable independent of sockets or HTTP UI (principle-boundary-discipline, principle-model-the-domain)

decision: Implement dual-format codecs (modern >= 6.4.25 byte-array fields and legacy ||| string framing) for Clipboard and File Transfer
why: UltraViewer peers check partner version >= 6.4.25 before choosing byte-array vs pipe-delimited framing
evidence: dis_sendfile2.txt at 0x747469, dis_saveupload2.txt at 0x757b2e, and dis_f1_manipulate.txt at 0x70109a..0x702a6e

decision: Implemented protocol.rs, screen.rs, input.rs, audio.rs, clipboard.rs, file_transfer.rs, session.rs, server.rs, main.rs, viewer.html, and run.sh
why: Port all Python protocol/screen/input/session/server modules to Rust and add G.722 audio, bidirectional clipboard sync, and chunked file transfer
result: All modules compiled cleanly without warnings in debug and release profiles

decision: Fixed G.722 step-size shift direction and session packet discriminator routing
why: G.722 scale_det required bidirectional shift when wd2 < 0 and encode_byte_array_fields packets start with u32 length 1 before the kind byte at offset 4
result: Eliminated arithmetic overflow in G.722 QMF/ADPCM and prevented 1-byte discriminator packets from being misrouted as kind-1 screen frames

why: Prove that all Rust unit/integration tests, all 40 existing Python reference tests, and the release binary pass end-to-end
evidence: cargo test (10 suites passed), python3 -m unittest discover -v (40 tests OK), curl smoke test on port 18765
result: Zero test failures and verified live responses on /status, /clipboard, and /files
